kind: round 2: first live run failed, subsequent live collector run earned the +1

failed_run.detail: 'Visit the page via coins' was tapped but no +1 was observed (balance None -> None)
failed_run.diagnosis: The tap named a row that was still inside the search swipe's fling; the next frame had carried it above the fold, so the shortcut sheet never opened. The pre-read route accepted the stale boost sheet as the coin page, so both balance reads were None and no pinned intent was fired.

fix.row_search: a gentler 0.4-viewport swipe with a 700 ms drag, followed by a bounded stability wait; the row is re-resolved on a settled frame immediately before the tap
fix.balance_pre_read: the route must replace the pre-route frame (or pass through loading) before the balance is trusted; an unreadable balance fails as balance_unreadable_before with no tap
fix.launch: after the pinned SHORTCUT_LAUNCH_DEEP_LINK, wait for the launched coin page, poll for the readable +1, and spend at most one reload if the first read cannot see it

live_run.run_status: failed on other families; the shortcut task itself completed
